dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the artifacts: ADB-based app launch, tap, swipe, text entry, UI inspection, and screenshots for DuoPlus cloud phones.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Commands are user-directed and generally require a target device ID, but the examples use broad natural-language device-control requests and do not add explicit confirmation guidance for sensitive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is ordinary ClawHub or local skill-copy installation; the included helper script is visible and sends only local ADB broadcast commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: ADB access, UI dumps, screenshots, and local cwebp compression are proportionate for cloud-phone automation, but they can expose whatever is visible on the device.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No credential storage, background persistence, self-modification, remote exfiltration, or privilege-escalation mechanism is shown; privilege comes from the connected Android device and signed-in apps.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The activation examples are broad, but they are consistent with a device-control skill and still require an intended device/action context rather than hidden automatic execution.
[SQP-2] expected: The skill clearly discloses screenshots, UI reading, and ADB automation; the scanner concern is best treated as missing privacy guidance, not evidence of unrelated or deceptive behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Pulling UI hierarchy XML locally is part of the documented workflow for element targeting, though users should understand it may contain private on-screen text.
[SQP-2] expected: Capturing and pulling screenshots locally is expected for visual verification, but generated image files should be handled as sensitive data.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend OpenClaw to control the connected DuoPlus/Android device. Use explicit device IDs, avoid sensitive logged-in apps unless supervised, and delete local screenshots or UI dump files after analysis.
llm.summary: This skill does what it says: it controls a connected DuoPlus Android cloud phone, but users should treat that as real device access.
